propositions: CodeQL flags five alerts for clear-text logging of sensitive data that are over-approximations and not actual credential leaks.

Alerts 86 and 87 flag `data["secret_override"]["families"]` which contains only constant detector category names from SECRET_PATTERNS, never credential values, by design of the SecretFinding dataclass.
Alerts 83, 84, and 85 incorrectly taint argv remainder with the `--allow-secret-pattern` reason value, but the flag token is stripped from the argv before being printed in usage errors.
Usage error messages at flagged lines print only the command name, unrecognised option tokens, and surplus arguments—never the override reason or credential material.

Regression tests must pin the invariant that secret values and their fragments never appear in forced-write logs or usage error output, while category names and argument names remain visible for diagnostics.
